key_holding: No person may be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law or denied equal protection. No citizen may be granted privileges or immunities not granted on the same terms to all citizens. The busing limitation (Prop. 1 of 1979) constrains equal protection ONLY for pupil assignment; all other due process and equal protection guarantees are fully independent of federal interpretation.

evolution_chain.event: Due process bundled with double jeopardy, self-incrimination, and takings. Copied from 5th Amendment.
Takings clause separated out. Due process renumbered but substantively unchanged.
Due process finally gets own section. Equal protection ADDED for first time. Privileges and immunities added as (b). Language modernized.

case_law.rule: Section 7 due process is a structural feature of the Constitution that cannot be eliminated by initiative amendment. Prop. 115 lockstep can change interpretation methodology but cannot remove the right itself.

Prop. 7 (Res.Ch. 90, 1974) — Section 7 created with due process + equal protection + privileges and immunities
Prop. 1 (Res.Ch. 18, 1979) — busing limitation added to subdivision (a)
